title: ChatGPT tab multi-model Extension MVP
question: Can one trusted Chrome client capture an audible ChatGPT voice tab through the SSH-loopback route, invoke and attempt RVC, Beatrice 2, X-VC, and OpenVoice V2 from the Extension, hear transformed live output from at least two profiles, and retain immediate native fallback?
hypothesis: A versioned four-model roster, the existing generation-boundary selector, three live technical routes, and one bounded End-triggered OpenVoice preview can provide a manual multi-model MVP without automatic ChatGPT turn detection or a model-quality claim.

control.description: The same captured ChatGPT voice tab remains on the Extension's native-only route.

variants.description: RVC, Beatrice 2, and X-VC live trials plus an OpenVoice buffered preview, exercised sequentially from one Extension through one Gateway contract.

fixtures.manifest: Operator-authored ChatGPT voice prompts and the deployment model roster; freeze before approval without retaining captured audio.

environment.git_commit: Persist evidence only from the exact clean checked-out commit.
environment.runtime: Chrome 116+ unpacked Extension, pinned OpenSSH local forward, loopback Gateway, and exact roster-bound worker runtimes.
environment.hardware: Record a non-sensitive client/server/GPU class summary in the metadata-only result; never record host paths or identifiers.

model_revisions.roster: Freeze exact deployment profile IDs plus profile and configuration hashes before approval. Runtime pipeline UUIDs are created by protocol version 1 and are recorded only in the machine receipt.

procedure.summary: Validate the frozen roster and deterministic contracts, start the remote-loopback Gateway with one session, open the pinned SSH local forward, load the Extension on an audible ChatGPT voice tab, and confirm native audio first. The Extension/Gateway instrumentation writes a metadata-only runtime receipt for observed tab audio, configured loopback route, Gateway authentication, identity, output, stale, exclusivity, and fallback facts; it does not claim account authentication, an SSH handshake, or pin verification. A separately bound operator document explicitly asserts those three facts and records audible judgments. Invoke RVC, Beatrice 2, X-VC, and the End-triggered OpenVoice preview sequentially. After those four attempts, use the popup-only explicit failure-injection control to start a fifth OpenVoice generation on the same pipeline; record fallback.required plus native fallback activation for that dedicated probe, then stop and confirm cleanup.
procedure.warmup: Allow one documented cold start per real profile while native remains audible; warmup is not latency evidence.
commands: LV-054 freezes the EXP-005 runner command, prompt sequence, sample count, and report schema before approval
invalidation_conditions: The Chrome run does not capture a normal audible chatgpt.com voice tab after an explicit user gesture.

The required machine-generated extension_gateway_runtime receipt is missing, has the wrong frozen revisions or deployment identities, omits a required fact/event, or is replaced by a boolean-only operator document.
The separately bound operator document does not explicitly assert authenticated ChatGPT account, established SSH tunnel, and verified pinned server identity.
RVC, Beatrice 2, X-VC, or OpenVoice V2 is not invocable and attempted from the Extension.
Fewer than two distinct live model profiles produce audible finite changed output through the Extension.
OpenVoice is represented as live/streaming or its preview is not bounded and End-triggered.
Any of the four frozen roster entries remains unavailable at experiment approval or execution.
Native and transformed paths are audible together, native fallback is unavailable, or stale output is accepted after cancel or profile switch.
The Gateway is not remote-loopback-only with max_sessions=1, or the client bypasses pinned SSH, bearer, exact Origin, or one-use ticket controls.
The result retains raw audio, credentials, target/reference data, host paths, or model weights.
A technical listening outcome is presented as a content, speaker, quality, latency, security, or release pass.

decision_rule: The experiment remains inconclusive for quality. A technical MVP pass requires an extension_gateway_runtime machine receipt bound to the frozen four-model roster and operator-plan content digests, observed audible ChatGPT tab and configured SSH-loopback route plus authenticated one-session Gateway facts, and separately bound manual_operator assertions for authenticated ChatGPT account, established SSH tunnel, and verified pinned server identity. It additionally requires RVC, Beatrice 2, X-VC, and OpenVoice runtime attempts with exact deployment identities and dynamic protocol-v1 pipeline and generation IDs, at least two distinct live profiles with finite changed output and separately bound audible judgments, an explicitly bounded End-triggered non-live OpenVoice preview, exclusive native-or-remote playout with zero accepted stale output, and one dedicated fifth OpenVoice failure probe on the preview pipeline with a new later generation ID, machine-only explicit injection fact, and linked fallback.required plus native fallback activation. A deterministic fake, spontaneous fallback, or boolean-only listening form cannot pass.

artifact_policy.raw_location: Captured and transformed audio stays in process memory and is not retained. Optional metadata-only traces use an operator-selected location outside Git.
artifact_policy.git_contents: Plan, safe roster schema/reason codes, runner source, tests, aggregate metadata, and no audio, credentials, voices, weights, runtime paths, or machine identifiers.
artifact_policy.retention: Delete optional local metadata traces after review or within 14 days. Do not retain audio recordings for this MVP gate.
artifact_policy.authorization: Use only the operator's authorized account, prompts, model artifacts, and target/reference material. Each trial profile must carry its existing technical authorization/provenance binding.
